_comment: Galaxy-mode drag listener — pointermove updates draggingPointerWorld + draggingNearestHubId via hub-geometry.findNearestHub; a transient tether overlay renders. Implementer adds data-component='galaxy-drag-tether' on the SVG/Canvas tether overlay element so a snapshot reviewer can eyeball it. Sets up clone-drag state via Inspector clone (depends on EBR2-F-03 having shipped).

steps.js: (() => { const set = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_SET_VIEW_MODE__; if (typeof set === 'function') set('canvas'); return 'canvas'; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const node = src.nodes[0]; ed.selectNode(node.nodeId); ed.setEditorMode('edit'); src.cloneNode(node.nodeId); return ed.draggingNodeId; })()

(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); if (!canvas) return null; const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2; const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) { canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: cx + i * 8, clientY: cy + i * 4, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 })); } return { cx, cy }; })()

(() => { const ed = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__.graphEditor.getState(); const tetherEl = document.querySelector('[data-component="galaxy-drag-tether"]'); return typeof ed.draggingNodeId === 'string' && !!tetherEl && typeof ed.draggingNearestHubId === 'string'; })()
